title: Returning errors
hints: By convention the error is the last result. Return a nil error on success, and a non-nil error, with the other results set to their zero values, on failure.
strconv.Atoi already returns (int, error); check its error first. errors.New and fmt.Errorf create new errors with a message.

n, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSpace(s)); if err != nil { return 0, fmt.Errorf("age %q is not a number", s) }; if n < 0 || n > 150 { return 0, fmt.Errorf("age %d is out of range", n) }; return n, nil
